appraisal_events.evidence: J'espère que vous me ferez le plaisir de venir avec Madame votre grand'mère.
appraisal_events.explanation: Charlus explicitly extends his tea invitation to the narrator's grandmother as well, including her alongside the narrator in the same socially valued gathering.

status_effects.explanation: She is named by Charlus as a welcome guest at the private tea, extending to her the same social inclusion granted to the narrator.
